description.value: Victory Cove Seaside Cottages is a remote wilderness fishing and nature retreat founded in 2017, situated on a float in the sheltered waters of Victory Bay on the Work Channel Inlet in Northwest British Columbia. The property offers a range of accommodations from bunkhouse rooms to nine-person chalets, alongside guest moorage, guided fishing charters, and daily complimentary coffee. The inlet is a rich marine ecosystem frequented by humpback whales, orcas, black bears, and bald eagles, making it a true off-grid basecamp for adventure.
